title: Filter normalized LibraryProfiles no-op changes
summary: Reconcile settings patch changed/removed keys after backend normalization so LibraryProfiles submissions that normalize back to the active config are treated as no-op changes.
reason: The Review Settings Changes dialog could show LibraryProfiles as changed even when the submitted profile payload matched the active settings after backend normalization, making a confirmed save appear not to stick.

behavior_after: Settings patch preview/save recomputes changed and removed keys from the final merged config before risk, diff, preview, and save decisions.
